description: Angular component for configuring label widget settings, including background image and labels management with drag-and-drop functionality.

classes.name: LabelWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for label widget configuration, extending WidgetSettingsComponent, managing form controls for background image and labels, with drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default widget settings including a base64-encoded SVG background image and empty labels array.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: doUpdateSettings
methods.description: Updates the form controls with new settings.

methods.name: prepareLabelsFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array from labels, each with validation.

methods.name: labelsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of labels.

methods.name: trackByLabelControl
methods.description: Track function for label controls in templates.

methods.name: removeLabel
methods.description: Removes a label at specified index.

methods.name: addLabel
methods.description: Adds a new default label to the form.
